name: PanVK Kbase — RC3 lowmem
displayVersion: RC3 lowmem (Mesa 5a07217f, csf-v11 + jm-v9; only Mali-G615 retested; v14 untested)
author: abhay-byte
description: Experimental PanVK driver for Mali GPUs on mali_kbase (Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14). RC3 plus lower-memory BC1 RGB and BC7 texture shadows (AFRC 8 bpp, slightly lower quality). Tested on Mali-G615 (v11); the rest of the RC3 matrix was not rerun. Bundled in this APK.
